title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
UPDATED: 13:40 6th AUGUST 2026

Moderate thunderstorms are expected today, with the primary threats being big hail, severe winds and heavy rain/possible floodings

---Discussion---

Storms in Poland should be scattered, but a one exception is made for the north-eastern part where the ENHD risk lays, where a quasi-linear system, with very strong wind gusts is forecast by multiple models.
Due to the newest model runs, there is a low tornado threat for the ENHD area, very favourable environment exists for tornado formation

About the storms in Czechia and Austria, they are expected to be scattered/isolated cells, with few larger systems possible mainly in the Austria Tyrol, where training thunderstorms are also possible.

Near the Czech-Austrian border (hatched risk) we could see extensive rainfall, with measured values of 80+mm/3hrs possible, which would eventually cause damaging floodings in the area.

---Risk Areas---

ENHD
Poland

Similar threats as in SLGT, but increased probabilities.
The main threats are:
- hail - up to 3.5cm
- Severe wind gusts - 90+km/h possible
- Heavy rain
- Tornado - A low tornado potential exists, as the dew points, lls, moisture and more parameters needed for tornado formation exist over the area

SLGT
Austria, Czechia & Poland

Moderate thunderstorms are expected in most of the area through out the day.
The main threats are:
- Hail - up to 3.5
- Stronger wind gusts - mainly in Poland
- Heavy rain - mainly in Czechia-Austria
- Floodings - due to the heavy rain

---Hatched Areas---

Hatched
Czechia & Austria

Issued for mainly extensive rainfall.
The main threat is:
- Heavy rain - Some models prompting up to 80mm/3hrs
- Damaging Floods - CONDITIONAL
